camera.reason: One 48MP sensor-shift OIS main camera with 2x crop zoom; no ultrawide or telephoto.

performance.reason: Apple A19 Pro, the same chip family as the 17 Pro, runs every game at high settings.

battery.reason: 3,149mAh in a 5.6mm body lasts a day for most, and charging is about 20W wired.

display.reason: 6.5 inch LTPO OLED at 1 to 120Hz with 3,000 nits outdoor peak.

build.reason: Grade 5 titanium frame with Ceramic Shield on both sides and IP68, at 5.6mm and 165g.

software.reason: Apple commits to at least 5 years of security updates (UK PSTI statement) and has historically shipped about 6 major iOS upgrades.

value.reason: 394,000 buys the thinnest iPhone, but iPhone 17 costs the same with an ultrawide and a bigger battery.

availability.reason: In stock at Daraz's Apple Flagship Store, PriceOye and Shophive with authorised distributor warranty.

notes: Sold in Pakistan as iPhone 17 Air by some retailers. 12GB 256GB: Daraz Apple Flagship Store 393,999 (in stock, 2 years brand warranty); PriceOye 401,999 and Shophive 416,999 also in stock; Mega.pk 424,999 out of stock. 512GB and 1TB are Shophive's in-stock prices (508,499 and 588,499). eSIM only, no physical SIM tray. RAM is 12GB per GSMArena; PriceOye labels it 8GB. Mega.pk's unlabeled 'Apple iPhone Air' listing at 274,999 does not say PTA or non-PTA, so it is not used. No clearly labeled non-PTA unit was found. osUpdates is an assumption.
